selection.diff_summary:
Summary: The change refactors OpenMP offload plugin launch sizing so the maximum number of blocks is no longer a fixed device-wide constant. A new virtual getBlockLimit(NumThreads) API is introduced in GenericDeviceTy and overridden by AMDGPUDeviceTy to compute a thread-count-dependent block cap from the device grid limit and thread limit, with clamping for zero threads and 32-bit overflow. GenericKernelTy is updated to pass EffectiveNumThreads when clamping both user-specified and preferred block counts, replacing the prior no-argument limit lookup.
Mechanisms: API change from fixed block-limit query to per-thread-count block-limit computation; AMDGPU-specific launch bound calculation using grid-items = max teams * thread limit and max blocks = grid-items / requested threads; Kernel launch configuration clamping now depends on EffectiveNumThreads for both explicit and preferred block counts; Preservation of existing behavior that clamps rather than fully honoring oversized user block requests
Touched symbols: GenericDeviceTy::getBlockLimit(uint32_t); AMDGPUDeviceTy::getBlockLimit(uint32_t); GenericKernelTy::getEffectiveNumBlocks; GridValues.GV_Max_Teams; getThreadLimit(); EffectiveNumThreads
